title: ART DECO STYLE TABLE LAMP H-50...
reason: Decorative figural Art Deco style lamp that could be worth more if period or by a known maker, but unmarked and likely a reproduction.
findings: Figural table lamp: three draped female figures with flowing hair and a fluted tail-like stem in a bright silver or chrome finish, supporting a round amber crackle glass globe, on a stepped hexagonal black painted timber plinth. Lit in the first photo, so it appears to work. No maker's mark, patent stamp or foundry mark visible (underside not shown). The painted timber base and soft casting detail suggest a later decorator reproduction rather than a 1930s original; period figural lamps of this type are usually stamped or labelled and none is seen here. Value is a judgement from the photos only, not price-checked.
condition: Silver finish flaking and pitted on the stem and near the base flare, with dark patches showing; black base scuffed and chipped at the edges; globe looks intact with no chips seen.
rescore_note: Three-nymph figural lamp with amber crackle glass globe, silver finish flaking and base chipped, no maker mark; looks like a later decorator reproduction not a 1930s original, with only a small chance of better. Judged $30 to $80 band. Not price-checked (search limit hit).
